Name: Neck,Head
Description: This will create a Neck and a Head System

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create a Neck and a Head System. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. HeadCtrlType: choose one option (for example: octagon, hexagon, square, sphere). Ribbon: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. SecundaryRibbon: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 3). CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: yellow, lightBlue, blue, white). Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, Head_Ctrl.
